name: Khoufu Account Manager Bot
description: Telegram shop bot: sell accounts, channels, groups, bots & methods + owner account manager.

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB connection string (MongoDB Atlas free works)

OWNER_IDS.description: Owner Telegram user IDs, separated by space

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Log channel ID (e.g. -100123...). Add the bot as admin there.

PARALLEL_ACCOUNTS.description: Accounts processed at the same time

MAX_FLOOD_WAIT.description: Skip a step if Telegram asks to wait longer than this (seconds)

ORDER_TIMEOUT.description: Minutes before an unpaid order is cancelled

FORCE_JOIN.description: Optional must-join channels (usernames or -100 ids, space separated). Can also be set in the bot.
